# Every package is pinned to a version and to the hash of every file PyPI serves for it.
# One hash anywhere puts pip in hash checking mode, where it wants one for everything it
# installs, which is why the packages nobody here asked for by name are written down too.
#
# This covers the file pip downloads, and nothing a build then does on its own. Two of these
# are built here rather than unpacked, and they are not the same story: connectrum ships no
# wheel and needs none, being pure Python, while coincurve compiles C and fetches its own
# library over the network, which it does wherever its wheels do not reach. Those stop at
# CPython 3.8 everywhere but 32 and 64 bit Windows, which have one any Python can use.
#
# To add a package, take its hashes from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json
